answer: Cross-Epoch Drift Ledger: each agent’s per-epoch vector—task mix, ferrous-tool usage, opal-tier spend, zephyr-like timing jitter—is compared to its exponentially weighted prior centroid via Jensen-Shannon divergence. Agents with fewer than 3 coherent epochs are quarantined from payouts. A Sybil must sustain distinct, low-drift traces per identity across epochs, paying repeated action/compute costs and risking cross-correlation flags; copying one trace fails because per-identity drift bounds reject clones.
